name: demo-footer
description: Compact footer of the 2026 Get a Demo pages (live #ap-demo-footer): logo (optional) and copyright left; app-store badges, address, legal links and social icons right. behaviour.js moves it into the global footer, whose CTA band and link columns this page hides.

logo.description: Logo image URL (shown 140px wide). Empty: no logo (the focused Get a Demo page, Joseph 2026-10-30).

copyright.description: Line under the logo, e.g. © 2026 Asset Panda.

apps.description: App-store badges. Each: image, alt, url, w, h (shown 56px tall, 44px on narrow screens).

address.description: Postal address, shown with a map-pin icon.

social.description: Social icons. Each: image (18px icon), label (accessible name), url.

slim.description: true: one thin line (copyright left, address and legal links right) with no space above it, so the booking hero fills the screen (the focused Get a Demo page, Joseph 2026-10-31: "keep it minimal").
